definitions.explanation: Many things or people doing something at the same time together.

examples.english: The flowers all bloomed at once.

examples.japanese: {一斉|いっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧とともに、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一斉|いっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: At the signal, the athletes all started running at once.

notes:
{一斉|いっせい} indicates simultaneous action by many.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {一斉|いっせい}に (all at once)
- No-adjective: {一斉|いっせい}の + noun / noun + {一斉|いっせい}

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一斉|いっせい}に + verb (do simultaneously)
- {一斉|いっせい}{検査|けんさ} (simultaneous inspection)
- {一斉|いっせい}{攻撃|こうげき} (simultaneous attack)
- {一斉|いっせい}{送信|そうしん} (mass transmission/broadcast)
